_about: Government Office Regions, identical across all nine UK studies that carry
them. The ONLY disagreement in 99,784 rows is the capital T in 35M5CV_sky's
'Yorkshire and The Humber'. That is typography, which CONVENTIONS says may be
normalised, not wording, which may never be.
Northern Ireland is absent everywhere. That is a property of the YouGov
studies rather than a gap in this map -- see the 'Great Britain, not the UK'
note in SocSci-UK_MASTER.md 5a and ledger 101. It is deliberately NOT added as
a canonical value nobody can produce.
